name: Frühstückspension
beschreibung:
Set in a sunny scenic location in Telfes im Stubai, this welcoming breakfast guesthouse offers comfortable rooms and a hearty morning buffet. Personalized hospitality makes guests feel right at home.

The Schlick 2000 hiking resort, the StuBay leisure pool center, and local transit links are only moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: The bed and breakfast pension in Telfes im Stubai features a family atmosphere and relaxation in the Stubai Valley.
